scope: Generic source-stage adapter, documentation and tests only; no actual release policy selected.

producer_checks.name: test-first baseline
producer_checks.result: Observed missing CLI; 33 tests, 38 failing test/subtest assertions, exit 1 before implementation.

producer_checks.name: initial source checks
producer_checks.result: 33 tests PASS, then two malformed-type regressions observed failing before explicit type-validation fix.

producer_checks.name: independent review defect regressions
producer_checks.result: Header/separator false accepts and nested-JSON/surrogate non-JSON exits independently reproduced before repair. Four targeted test functions ran RED; explicit original-data alias was passing control.

producer_checks.name: actual canonical queue parser
producer_checks.result: 187 records, all 122 numbered requests, no duplicate canonical IDs; headers/separators excluded; 183 permitted table-backed records and non-table COMP1 plus three held IDs not selected.

findings: M12-SOL-001 P2: table header/separator mistaken for original data row
M12-SOL-002 P3: deeply nested JSON and invalid UTF-8 path bypass structured error output

round_two.actual_queue_cli: 183 permitted synthetic table-backed selections accepted; 187 canonical records retained

inline_simplification.reuse: No behavior-equivalent existing helper imported; validator remains standalone standard-library code.
inline_simplification.quality: Replaced a compact exception-generating lambda with an explicit invalid-constant handler; retained trust-boundary checks.
inline_simplification.efficiency: Git object reads are cached; no hot-path or network integration added. No speculative optimization.

limitations: Caller independently accepts expected pins, policy, receipt provenance and input-closure completeness.
Matching source bytes prove identity/presence, not feature behavior.
Matching accepted receipt bytes do not independently prove execution.
Non-table COMP1 is visible but unselectable; nonselection cannot waive an existing obligation.
source_delivery: This is the frozen pre-delivery verification receipt. Remote ref/tree/byte readback and later consumer intake are separate subsequent receipts.
